title: Composed supervisory control: Pause/resume sequence with abort recovery -> State sequence with per-stage timeout

inputs.name: B_Stop
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Stop and reset-to-idle command

outputs.name: A_State
outputs.description: Subsystem A: 0 idle, 1 step1, 2 step2, 3 done

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
The runtime scan period is 100 ms.
Sensor completion is expected within 500 ms of entering each stage.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Start shall begin Step 1 only when idle and not A_Aborted.
requirements.property: G((A_State=0 AND A_Start AND !A_Aborted AND !A_Abort) -> X(A_State=1))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Advance shall move Step 1 to Step 2 and Step 2 to done only while not A_Paused.
requirements.property: G((A_Advance AND !A_Paused AND A_State=1)->X(A_State=2)) AND G((A_Advance AND !A_Paused AND A_State=2)->X(A_State=3))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Pause shall suppress active step outputs without losing A_State; A_Resume clears A_Paused.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Abort shall return A_State to idle, suppress outputs, clear A_Paused, and latch A_Aborted.
requirements.property: G(A_Abort -> (A_State=0 AND !A_Step1 AND !A_Step2 AND !A_Paused AND A_Aborted))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear A_Aborted only while A_Start, A_Advance, A_Pause, A_Resume, and A_Abort are all FALSE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Start in idle shall enter stage 1 and energize only B_Actuator1.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Sensor1 shall transition stage 1 to stage 2; B_Sensor2 shall B_Complete stage 2 and return idle.
requirements.property: G((B_State=1 AND B_Sensor1)->X(B_State=2)) AND G((B_State=2 AND B_Sensor2)->X(B_State=0))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Either stage remaining incomplete for 500 ms shall latch B_Fault and return idle with both actuators off.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Stop shall return idle and turn both actuators off without clearing B_Fault.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_ResetFault clears B_Fault only while B_Stop is TRUE and B_Start is FALSE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Complete shall pulse only on the stage-2-to-idle completion transition.
A TRUE A_Step1 shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
